final: WITH c AS (SELECT a.district_id AS district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), r AS (SELECT c.*, AVG(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM c), h AS (SELECT district_id, region, cnt, cnt - region_avg AS excess FROM r WHERE cnt > region_avg), x AS (SELECT district_id, region, cnt AS account_count, excess, cnt * 1.0 / AVG(cnt) OVER () AS ratio FROM h), k AS (SELECT x.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS rk FROM x) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess, ratio FROM k WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY ratio DESC
